dataset_meta.purpose: Synthetic onboarding profiles for testing the auto-proposal rule engine and document generator. All companies, contacts, and figures are fictional.
dataset_meta.note_on_asymmetry: Fields are intentionally uneven in depth/completeness, reflecting real onboarding forms filled out under time pressure by different people.

company_details.value_proposition: We get local and multi-location service businesses found on Google before their competitors — without the agency jargon.
products_and_services: Local SEO (Google Business Profile, citations, review strategy)
Light social media posting (add-on for Growth+ tiers)
company_details.target_customers: Local and regional service businesses (dental, legal, home services, multi-location retail) with 1–10 physical locations who rank poorly against competitors on Google.

ideal_customer.description: An owner-operator or ops manager at a 1–10 location service business who knows they're invisible on Google but has no in-house marketing person to fix it.
ideal_customer.pain_points: Not showing up in Google Maps/local pack. Competitors outranking them despite being a worse business. No time to manage this in-house.

buyer_segments: Franchise groups needing consistent local presence across locations
offer.cost_of_doing_nothing: Every month without ranking, competitors who ARE investing in local SEO capture the searches you're missing — and those are compounding losses, not one-time ones, since rankings take 3-6 months to build once you start.
discovery_questions: How many locations do you currently have, and are you planning to open more in the next 12 months?
Where do you currently rank for your top 3-5 target search terms?
Have you worked with an SEO agency before — what worked or didn't?
What does a new customer/patient/client acquisition mean in dollar terms for you?
offer.what_happens_after_they_sign: Kickoff call within 3 business days → Google Business Profile + site audit (week 1) → keyword & competitor strategy delivered (week 2) → execution begins, first monthly report at day 30.
offer.evidenced_results: Multi-location dental client went from page 3 to top-3 local pack rankings in 4 of 6 target cities within 5 months.
who_is_not_a_good_fit: Businesses expecting first-page rankings within 30 days
Businesses unwilling to publish any new content or get on a monthly call
National e-commerce brands with no physical/local service area (different channel mix needed)

common_objections.objection: SEO takes too long, we need leads now.
common_objections.response: That's why most clients pair Growth+ with paid ads short-term while SEO compounds in the background — SEO is the channel that gets cheaper over time, not more expensive.

common_objections.objection: We tried SEO before and it didn't work.
common_objections.response: In our audits, that's almost always inconsistent execution, not a channel problem — we show you the audit findings before you sign so there's no guessing.

common_objections.objection: Can't we just do this ourselves?
common_objections.response: You can — most clients that come to us already tried and found it's a full-time job on top of their full-time job.

offer.why_buyers_pick_you: Plain-language monthly reporting (no vanity metrics), a dedicated strategist per account instead of a call-center account manager, and transparent tiered pricing with no long-term lock-in.
offer.guarantee_risk_reversal: Month-to-month after the initial 3-month minimum — no annual lock-in required (though annual prepay gets a discount). If you don't see ranking movement on agreed keywords by month 4, we do a free strategy reset call.

company_basics.timings: Mon–Fri, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM ET (24/7 emergency line for Premium clients)

company_details.value_proposition: Flat-rate, predictable IT support for 10-250 employee businesses that can't afford downtime and don't have an internal IT department.
products_and_services: Cybersecurity baseline (MFA, endpoint protection, phishing training)
vCIO / quarterly IT roadmap reviews (Premium tier)
company_details.target_customers: Professional services firms (law, accounting, healthcare admin), and small manufacturers/distributors with 10-250 employees and no in-house IT team.

ideal_customer.description: Office manager, COO, or managing partner at a 10-250 employee professional services or light-industrial business who currently either has no IT support or relies on a single overloaded 'IT guy'.
ideal_customer.pain_points: Recurring downtime and slow ticket response from current provider or internal IT. No real backup/disaster recovery plan. Compliance pressure (HIPAA, client data) with no documented security baseline. Unpredictable IT spend — surprise invoices for 'emergency' work.

offer.cost_of_doing_nothing: The average unplanned outage for a firm this size costs more in a single afternoon of lost billable/production time than a year of managed support — and that's before counting a real breach or ransomware event, where the cost is existential, not incremental.
discovery_questions: How many total employees need IT support, and across how many office locations?
What's your current setup — internal IT, a solo contractor, or nothing formal?
Do you have any compliance requirements (HIPAA, client data handling, cyber insurance requirements)?
Roughly how many servers, and any specialty/shared devices beyond one computer per employee?
Have you had a security incident or major outage in the last 12 months?
offer.what_happens_after_they_sign: Signed agreement triggers a network & security assessment within 5 business days, onboarding of all devices into our monitoring stack over week 1-2, staff introduced to the helpdesk portal, and a 30-day check-in call to confirm SLA response times are being met.
offer.evidenced_results: Reduced average ticket resolution time from 14 hours to under 2 hours for a 60-seat accounting firm client after onboarding; zero unplanned data-loss incidents across current client base since 2022 (internal tracking, not third-party audited).
who_is_not_a_good_fit: Businesses under 10 employees (better served by a lighter break-fix arrangement, not full managed services)
Businesses wanting only occasional break-fix support with no ongoing monitoring relationship
Businesses unwilling to standardize on our security baseline (non-negotiable for liability reasons)

common_objections.response: A single contractor is cheaper until they're on vacation during an outage — you're not just buying hours, you're buying coverage and a documented process.

common_objections.objection: We don't have the budget for full managed services.
common_objections.response: The Essential tier is built for exactly this — most clients starting there upgrade to Standard within a year as headcount grows.
Migration happens in the first two weeks with zero end-user downtime in the vast majority of onboardings — we've done this dozens of times.

offer.why_buyers_pick_you: Transparent per-seat pricing with no surprise invoices, documented SLA response times by tier, and a named account engineer instead of a rotating help-desk queue.
offer.guarantee_risk_reversal: 90-day satisfaction guarantee — if you're not satisfied in the first 90 days, we'll refund the difference between what you paid and a prorated month-to-month rate, no long-term contract penalty.

company_details.value_proposition: Fixed-price, fixed-timeline websites and e-commerce builds for small businesses who are tired of open-ended dev quotes.
products_and_services: Ongoing hosting & maintenance retainers (post-launch, sold separately)
company_details.target_customers: Small business owners and startups needing a new website or e-commerce store, generally 1-3 projects/year buyers, not enterprise procurement.

ideal_customer.description: A small business owner or solo founder who needs a professional website/store live within weeks, not months, and wants one clear price instead of an hourly estimate that could run anywhere.
ideal_customer.pain_points: Got burned by an open-ended freelancer quote before. Doesn't know what a website 'should' cost. Needs it live before a specific date (launch, season, event).

buyer_segments: Local/small business owners needing a first real website
Startups needing a custom web app MVP
offer.cost_of_doing_nothing: Every week without a real site is a week of losing customers to whichever competitor they find first on Google or Instagram — for e-commerce specifically, it's also revenue that's just not being captured at all.
discovery_questions: What's the main goal of the site — informational, lead capture, or direct sales?
Do you have a target launch date tied to an event, season, or campaign?
Roughly how many pages/products, and do you have existing content (copy, photos) ready?
Any must-have features — booking, custom checkout, membership/login?
offer.what_happens_after_they_sign: 50% deposit invoiced on signing → kickoff call within 2 business days → phase-by-phase build with review checkpoints → remaining balance due at delivery/launch.
offer.evidenced_results: Launched 40+ small business sites in the last 2 years, typical landing page delivered in 2 weeks, e-commerce builds in 4-6 weeks.
who_is_not_a_good_fit: Projects requiring unbounded custom scope with no fixed feature list (needs a discovery/scoping engagement first, not a template quote)
Clients wanting hourly, open-ended engagement rather than a fixed price
Enterprise procurement processes requiring RFP/legal review cycles

common_objections.objection: Why is this more than a $200 template site?
common_objections.response: Templates are the raw material — the price covers strategy, custom content integration, SEO setup, and testing, not just theme installation.

common_objections.objection: Can we pay all at the end instead of a deposit?
common_objections.response: The 50/50 split protects both sides — it's standard across every project we run, no exceptions.

common_objections.objection: Can you do it cheaper if we cut some pages?
common_objections.response: Yes — happy to scope down to the core pages you actually need and re-quote, that's a quick adjustment, not a renegotiation.

offer.why_buyers_pick_you: One fixed price agreed before work starts, a real delivery date, and a phase-by-phase review process so there are no surprise revisions at the end.
offer.guarantee_risk_reversal: If we miss the agreed delivery date for reasons on our side, the final payment milestone drops by 10% per week late, up to 30%.
